component.name: Specto
component.summary: View PDF documents and rearrange their pages

description.p: A fast PDF viewer with light editing, in the spirit of Preview on macOS. It stays responsive on huge documents and renders pages sharply at any zoom.

ul.li: Single page, continuous and two pages side by side
Thumbnails, table of contents, links and printed page numbers
Search, and selecting and copying text
Remembers where you were in each document
Highlight, underline and strike out text
Notes, text boxes, freehand drawings and shapes
Sign with a signature drawn or taken from a picture
Fill in forms, by pointer or by keyboard
Rotate, delete and reorder pages by dragging thumbnails
Insert pages from other documents, or drag them between windows
Export a selection of pages to a new document

screenshot.caption: Two pages side by side, with the table of contents in the sidebar

description.p: Specto is translated into more than 30 languages. Saving is much faster for large files when it only adds markup or fills in empty form fields.
New on the desktop: Trim Margins, Back and Forward after following a link, a preview of where a link leads, and a Properties dialog.
The first release: viewing, search, markup, signatures, forms, page editing and printing.
